converter.errors: No .err file observed in the initially empty scratch output directory. Converter execution transcript was not saved; package, binary, source, output hashes and command were observed.
converter.rerunNote: Recreate the script contents and scratch input with the pinned hash, and use a new empty scratch output directory. The named package and runtime image must be available locally; no download or network access is needed in the container.

comparison.agreement: Both converter exports report SUN 24C owner 246 (XRECORD), SUN 187 owner 94 (VPORT), XRECORD 246 owner 245 and background 261 reference to 24C. ODA adds a VIEW 242 group-361 reference to 24C and view extension-dictionary chain in this screen. The prior LibreDWG output bytes were not available for a new full field-by-field comparison.

contractAndDisposition.documentedRule: AcDbSun is a hard-owned child of an AcDbViewportTableRecord or AcDbViewport object. This API text does not establish an XRECORD owner.
contractAndDisposition.viewWireReferenceSummary: ODA DWG specification section 20.4.60 identifies VIEW group 361 as a SUN hard-owner reference; prior bounded output requires SUN owner equal VIEW. Here VIEW 242 references 24C but SUN common owner is 246.
contractAndDisposition.decision: Keep strict owner-graph refusal. Do not rewrite 24C owner to VIEW 242, treat XRECORD 246 as an admitted SUN owner, or promote support claims from these screens.

limits: ODA DXF export is a converter observation, not a byte-level proof of the original DWG handle stream; audit was disabled and no native open/render/reopen was performed.

Neither producer provenance nor whether ODA normalized any data was established. The group-330 owner, XRECORD payload group-330 reference, group-361 VIEW link and group-340 background reference have distinct roles and must not be conflated.

Existing generated VIEW/SUN route requires matching common owner and therefore does not establish a safe output profile for this outlier. Whole-document output and other dependencies were not qualified.
nextTrigger: A scratch-created, version-identified native AutoCAD/ObjectARX producer witness should record SUN ownerId, VIEW sunId, XRECORD ownerId and object classes, then save DWG and matching DXF and reopen both to inspect ownership, references and rendering; alternatively obtain an independently source-bound object-frame trace plus equivalent native evidence. Only then design any narrowly scoped mapping and rollback/readback tests.
